COS

COS (Collection of Style), founded in 2007 as a subsidiary of H&M, is known for its minimalist aesthetic and timeless designs. The brand combines modern sophistication with classic elements, offering stylish, practical wardrobe staples that transcend trends. COS appeals to those who appreciate simplicity, clean lines and understated luxury.

COS is known for its high-quality materials and craftsmanship, often blending natural fibres like cotton, wool and linen for durability and comfort. The brand’s muted colour palette, with neutrals like beige, grey and navy, plus occasional bold accents, makes it easy to mix and match for versatile outfits.

COS is also known for its sustainable approach to fashion. The brand has made significant strides toward reducing its environmental impact, incorporating more sustainable materials, improving production processes and committing to more transparent supply chains. COS operates with the belief that fashion should be thoughtful, lasting and responsible, both in terms of design and the environmental footprint.

With stores in major cities worldwide and a growing online presence, COS has cultivated a loyal following. Known for high-quality designs that prioritise “style over trend,” the brand has become a standout in contemporary fashion—and you can now shop their collections at BrandAlley.

COOKIES AND PRIVACY

Just so you know… We use cookies (including third party) to help improve your browsing experience and send you advertisements in line with your interests. You can learn more

Manage Consent Preferences

Functional Cookies

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Performance Cookies

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

Targeting Cookies

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites.
